queries: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg WHERE race_wins IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m1 FROM country_avg), kept AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, bench b WHERE ca.avg_wins > b.m1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m2 FROM kept) SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins AS average, k.avg_wins - b.m1 AS above_overall_benchmark, k.avg_wins - m2.m2 AS above_second_mean FROM kept k, bench b, m2 WHERE k.avg_wins > m2.m2 ORDER BY k.country

assumptions.assumption: Races with no driverStandings rows contribute nothing (inner join), so each country's races are only those having standings; per-race average ignores NULL wins via AVG.
The second mean is the simple mean of the kept countries' averages (each country once), and 'above' is measured as a plain difference.
